title.narrative: Ending HIV and tuberculosis (“TB”) epidemics through evidence-based interventions and innovative approaches with a focus on key and vulnerable populations - Tajikistan (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Tajikistan, TB/HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Tajikistan)This program has the following goals: To support Tajikistan public health system by ensuring HIV prevention, timely detection, access to ART, addressing related human rights barriers, as well as providing quality HIV care and support with the focus on key and vulnerable populations.. To decrease the burden of tuberculosis and its impact over the general social and economic development in the country, by ensuring universal access to timely and quality diagnosis and treatment of all forms of TB, including latent TB, which will decrease illness and deaths and prevent further development of drug resistance.. The objectives of this program are: To ensure effective HIV response measures among most at risk populations, - including prevention, early HIV diagnostics and immediate treatment initiation, - to reach 95-95-95 HIV care targets. To reach the pre-pandemic level of access to early and quality DR-TB diagnostics and treatment and scale up integrated people-centered model of TB care. To dramatically scale up efforts on TB/DR-TB prevention, including universal access to TB preventive treatment. To ensure integrated care for people affected both by TB and HIV disease. To strengthen national public heath response to ensure universal, people-centered, efficient, human rights and gender-responsive approach to HIV, TB and integrated TB/HIV services
